item.title: Fix bug in window.py so python3 -m unittest passes
item.brief: Operator request (authenticated, local socket): In this repository `python3 -m unittest` fails. Find and fix the bug in `window.py` so every test passes, without changing the tests, and make sure the function is correct for every input, not just the tested ones. Commit the fix on the local branch (ship is local; do not push). Commit as the configured git user only, with no tool or AI attribution in the message. Acceptance: `python3 -m unittest` exits 0 with all tests passing; no test files modified; the fixed function handles edge inputs (empty, boundary, negative, etc. as applicable) correctly by reading its logic, not only the tested cases.

reasons: sizer: elevated -> high; capped at medium; consider a stronger tier; unchanged

state.summary:
Fixed the off-by-one in window.py sliding_windows: the loop bound was range(len(items) - size), which dropped the final window. It is now range(len(items) - size + 1). Committed on archon/5xn5ag3g-fix-bug-in-window-py-so-python3-m-unitte as 3f6749413aef4a1d3933d2e37c7e7975fd1fb371 (tree 86fa2570260a2e082a57848f99c47518a99b485c), under the configured mengsig identity, no attribution lines. Nothing pushed; no test files touched. Before: python3 -m unittest exit 1, FAILED (failures=2). After: Ran 3 tests, OK, exit 0. Edge cases checked by reading and ad-hoc run: [] with size 1 gives []; [1] with size 1 gives [[1]]; size greater than len gives []; size equal to len gives one window; size 1 gives singletons; negative or zero size raises ValueError. pr.body: Approach: loop bound changed from range(len(items) - size) to range(len(items) - size + 1) in window.py. Only file changed. Before: python3 -m unittest exit 1, FAILED (failures=2). After: Ran 3 tests, OK, exit 0. Edge reads: empty list, size == len, size > len (empty result via negative range), size 1, and non-positive size (ValueError) all correct. Assumption: non-integer sizes are out of scope, as before. Review: one low-effort haiku reviewer passed the head with no findings.
pr.summary: made sliding_windows return every contiguous window. now python3 -m unittest passes. before: last window dropped, 2 tests failing; now: all 3 tests pass.
pr.title: Fix off-by-one in sliding_windows that dropped the last window
